reader.requirement: At --std 85 a report file (an FD with a REPORT clause) must have sequential organization, so its file control entry admits exactly the 1985 report-file clauses as the Sequential I-O module defines them (OPTIONAL, ASSIGN, RESERVE, [ORGANIZATION IS] SEQUENTIAL, PADDING CHARACTER, RECORD DELIMITER, ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL, FILE STATUS), and an indexed, relative, random/dynamic-access or later-edition organization or clause must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry FileOrganizationLineSequential2023: LINE SEQUENTIAL refused at 85
nothing: an INDEXED or RELATIVE file is Format 2 and its REPORT clause is refused at every edition

reader.edition-search: grep IsReportFile across Binding/; read FileDescriptionFormats.Of and FileControlBinder.MapOrganization; VersionConformancePass visitors for the file control clauses
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the 2002 LOCK MODE and SHARING clauses and the 2023 LINE SEQUENTIAL organization are refused on a report file at 85 and admitted later; the sequential-organization requirement itself is enforced the same way at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb773 and pb742 describe no report file; the report-file entry is not exercised by them

probes.printed: OPEN 00 / CLOSE 00 / D 002; MATCH (COBOL1778 warning: RECORD DELIMITER STANDARD-1 accepted with no effect)
probes.expected: every clause of the 1985 report-file entry accepted, the report written sequentially and read back
OPEN EXTEND of an absent OPTIONAL report file succeeds with status 05 (§1985:XIII.2.3.4 GR2)

probes.printed: COBOL2604 the REPORT clause is not a clause of Format 2: file 'PRT' is INDEXED
COBOL1858 ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM may not be specified for a sequential file
COBOL1858 ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC may not be specified for a sequential file
COBOL0900 ORGANIZATION LINE SEQUENTIAL requires COBOL-2023 (targeting COBOL-85)
COBOL0900 the LOCK MODE clause requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0900 the SHARING clause requires COBOL-2002

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.2.3.4 GR4  the text is in GR4
OK  §1985:XIII.2.3.3 SR4  the text is in SR4

reader.notes: A report file is bound as record sequential (MapOrganization defaults to Sequential). An INDEXED or RELATIVE one makes its FD Format 2, so the REPORT clause is refused (COBOL2604), and random/dynamic access is refused for a sequential file (COBOL1858). The full 1985 clause set runs, the later-edition organizations and clauses are refused at 85, and since the witnesses carry no report file these probes are the evidence.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 via run_case.py on a report file (FD PRT REPORT IS R1, no ORGANIZATION clause): z1 RECORD KEY, z3 ALTERNATE RECORD KEY refused COBOL0863 (indexed-only clause on a sequential file); z2 RELATIVE KEY refused COBOL0863 + COBOL0900; z4 2002 ASSIGN USING data-name refused (COBOL5506); z5 COLLATING SEQUENCE in the file control entry refused (COBOL5506); z6 ORGANIZATION RECORD BINARY SEQUENTIAL refused; z7 every optional word dropped and clauses reordered (ACCESS SEQUENTIAL ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL RESERVE 1 AREA RECORD DELIMITER STANDARD-1 STATUS FS, SR1 any order) compiles and runs; z8 RECORD DELIMITER implementor-name-2 accepted with the COBOL1778 no-effect warning; z9 PADDING CHARACTER a 4-char data-name refused COBOL6848 (VII.2.7.3 SR3); z10 OPEN OUTPUT then OPEN EXTEND of an existing report file appends sequentially: EXT 00, three D1 records read back. Together with the reader's INDEXED/RELATIVE (COBOL2604), RANDOM/DYNAMIC (COBOL1858), LINE SEQUENTIAL/LOCK MODE/SHARING (COBOL0900) refusals, no non-sequential form is admitted. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.2.3.4 GR4; OK §1985:XIII.2.3.3 SR4.
